newsitem.title: CHILE: Codelco El Teniente pit opens new mine in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Codelco El Teniente pit opens new mine in Sept.

text.p: The El Teniente division of Chile's state copper company Codelco said it will start copper production at its new Esmeralda mine in September, nine months earlier than scheduled.

Esmeralda will produce a modest five tonnes of copper a day in September with output rising to 58,000 tonnes a year in 2000 and 164,000 tonnes in 2005 when the pit's production is at a peak, the division said in a statement.
The mine, which will have an active life of around 30 years, has reserves of 424 million tonnes with an average copper grade of 0.96 percent.

The exploitation of Esmeralda is one of the projects included in the division's plan to boost annual output to 500,000 tonnes by the turn of the century from current levels of 350,000 tonnes. ((-- Margaret Orgill, Santiago newsroom, 562-699-5595x212))
